plan.title: Implement the directive bootstrap launcher and repoint operator docs (Phase 4)

narratives.Description: The settled decision is to implement a directive bootstrap thin launcher rather than a skill-only setup policy. This story adds a bootstrap handler in dispatch.ts that deposits if absent, carries phase intent and a deliberate re-entry signal, and hands off to deft-directive-setup, then updates the setup skill and operator docs. It runs in parallel with the other phases since it is additive.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Add a bootstrap handler in packages/cli/src/dispatch.ts that deposits when absent, passes phase intent plus a deliberate-re-entry signal, and hands off to the deft-directive-setup skill, with a dispatch test covering the new verb.
- Update content/skills/deft-directive-setup/SKILL.md for the launcher hand-off and repoint content/UPGRADING.md and README.md citations from run bootstrap, project, and spec to directive bootstrap.
narratives.UserStory: As a terminal operator starting a project, I want a directive bootstrap launcher, so that I can bootstrap and hand off to setup without the legacy run bootstrap path.
